changeSet.author: Axelix Team
changeSet.comment: Fills users_roles from the legacy users.roles JSON column. The column itself is intentionally left in place: it is kept up to date so that a rollback to a previous Axelix version does not lose the role assignments.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO users_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT DISTINCT u.id, r.id FROM users u JOIN JSON_TABLE(u.roles, '$[*]' COLUMNS (role_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) AS jt JOIN roles r ON r.name = UPPER(TRIM(jt.role_name)) WHERE u.roles IS NOT NULL AND u.roles <> '';
